subject: Damaged units in last delivery
action: Thank you for flagging this. Please send photos of the affected units, the batch/lot number, and your proposal for credit or replacement. We'll confirm within 24 hours.

subject: Shipment update
action: Please send the AWB, vessel/container number and the ETD/ETA for this shipment so we can update our tracking sheet and notify the customer.

subject: URGENT - production delay
action: Noted on the delay - I need a firm revised ship date in writing today, plus the reason. If the new date slips our window we'll need to split the shipment and air-freight the shortfall at your cost. Please confirm by end of day.

subject: Re: PO-1042 quotation request
action: Thanks for your email. Could you confirm your best unit price, MOQ and lead time for the quantities on our last order? We're ready to place the next one this week and will confirm on receipt.

subject: Invoice INV-88213 attached
action: Thanks - we have the invoice. Our finance runs payments on the 15th and 30th; please confirm the PO number matches so it clears on the next run without a query.
